propositions: Mapping configuration block must be registered as a reserved section in _RESERVED_SECTIONS and read raw via read_reserved_section without triggering _warn_unknown or hard-error under REBAR_CONFIG_UNKNOWN_KEYS=error

Axis maps (status_map, type_map, link_map, priority_map, create_defaults) must deep-merge per key with precedence built-in ← default ← projects.<KEY>, allowing unnamed keys to inherit and overlay entries to override only named keys

Vocabulary declarations (statuses, issue_types, link_types lists and hierarchy table) must replace wholesale with most-specific-wins semantics, not unioned, so a project's vocabulary fully supersedes outer layers

Validation must fail closed offline at config load time when axis-map values fall outside declared vocabulary, blocks are malformed (non-mapping sub-tables, non-string values, non-string-list vocabulary), or reference capability-absent axes, raising MappingConfigError
Capability descriptor must declare which mapping axes a target has (has_types, has_transitions, has_hierarchy, has_link_types, has_priorities) gating corresponding axis maps

Module must be provider-neutral with no imports from adapters.jira_family and no Jira value literals, with adapter injection of built-ins and capabilities respecting vendor-adapter seam dependency direction
